facts.label: Talent data
facts.value: The pinned snapshot has 17 new Warlock talents, including Wrack, Pandemic, Demonic Brand, Demonic Knowledge, Demonic Pact, Bane of Havoc and Incinerate. Fifteen Classic talents are gone, such as Dark Pact, Devastation and Improved Healthstone. Only Improved Voidwalker and Improved Sayaad are unchanged, and Improved Life Tap, Grim Reach and Destructive Reach only moved.
facts.recheck: Checked against the 16 October talent data; not yet re-checked against the 10 November data.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Curse of Agony and Curse of Doom are now Banes, and each Warlock can keep only one Bane on a target. Curse of the Elements now covers all magic schools, and Curse of Shadows is gone.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Firestone and Spellstone are weapon imbues that stack with other temporary enchants such as Wizard Oil, so your off-hand is free. Firestone adds Fire damage and spell crit; Spellstone adds Shadow damage and spell haste.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Life Tap scales with Spirit. Drain Soul's chance to give a Soul Shard rises every tick until it is certain, and a non-trivial kill always gives one.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Demons scale from your own stats, Voidwalker Sacrifice scales with 10% of your spell healing, and your current pet is stunned while you summon another one.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Demonic Sacrifice moved to 11 points, lasts 2 hours and swapped its effects; Master Demonologist uses the opposite pairing. Demonic Pact at 31 points keeps the sacrifice when you summon a different demon, so both effects can be combined.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Forever adds the Incubus, a male counterpart to the Succubus, and calls Enslave Demon 'Subjugate Demon'. Improved Shadow Bolt now boosts only your own Shadow damage, so it no longer helps the raid.

facts.label: Not settled yet
facts.value: talentsforever's 30 Oct datamine: Improved Drains now covers Drain Life, Drain Soul and Drain Mana, and Wrack was dropped from it. The files also show Healthstones healing as if fully talented (Major Healthstone: 1,440). No Blizzard note confirms the hotfix yet.

facts.label: Demon quests: Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, Felhunter (1, 10, 20, 20 and 30)
facts.value: Warcraft Tavern's beta guide says each demon comes from a class quest, and demon trainers sell grimoires for pet abilities. Named quests: 'Devourer of Souls' (Succubus), 'What Is Love?' (Incubus, Stormwind) and 'Seeking Strahad' (Felhunter).

facts.label: Ritual of Summoning and Create Soulstone (20 and 18)
facts.value: Datamined spellbook levels. The ritual needs you plus two helpers. Meeting stones reportedly do not summon in Forever, so this ritual is the only summon (Warcraft Tavern).

facts.label: Inferno (Infernal) (50)
facts.value: Classic: a level-50 quest from Niby the Almighty in Felwood; collect three Flawless Fel Essences, then defeat a summoned Infernal. The Forever files list the spell at 50 with Classic text, but whether the quest is the same is unverified.

facts.label: Ritual of Doom (Doomguard) (60)
facts.value: Classic: learned at 60, uses a Demonic Figurine and needs you plus four party members. The Forever files list it at 60 with Classic text; how you unlock it there is unverified.

facts.label: Felsteed and Dreadsteed (40 and 60 in Classic)
facts.value: Classic: the Felsteed comes from a level-40 quest (Strahad Farsan in Ratchet) and the Dreadsteed from a long level-60 chain that ends in a Dire Maul ritual. Neither spell is in the datamined Forever spellbook and no Forever source mentions them, so their status is unconfirmed.

facts.label: Warlock hit from talents
facts.value: Suppression: up to 5% hit with all spells and up to 20% less threat
facts.note: Snapshot and datamine: 1% hit and 4% less threat per rank, 5 ranks. Classic's version only reduced resists on Affliction spells.

facts.label: Spell hit cap against raid bosses (Forever)
facts.note: No official Forever value has been published.

facts.label: Classic 1.12 hit cap (reference only)
facts.value: 16% spell hit against bosses three levels higher and 3% against same-level targets; 1% of spells always miss

facts.label: Shadow crit
facts.value: Malevolence adds up to 5% Shadow crit, and Pandemic up to 100% more crit damage bonus on DoTs and drains

facts.label: Wrack (snapshot)
facts.value: 36 Shadow damage every 1 sec at rank 1, and your other Shadow DoTs deal 10% more to the target for 6 sec; needs Siphon Life
facts.recheck: Checked against the 16 October talent data; not yet re-checked against the 10 November data.

facts.label: Spirit and mana
facts.value: Life Tap now scales with Spirit

facts.label: Curse of the Elements
facts.value: Raises damage taken from all magic schools; Curse of Shadows is gone
facts.note: talentsforever: 4 ranks (levels 20, 30, 40 and 50); the top rank lowers magic resistances by 75 and adds 10% magic damage taken.

facts.label: One Bane per Warlock
facts.value: Each Warlock can keep only one Bane on a target, and anything that worked with Curses also works with Banes

facts.label: Curse plus Bane (untested)
facts.value: Read literally, the tooltips allow one Curse and one Bane from the same Warlock on a target at once
facts.note: talentsforever datamine. Nobody has tested it, so agree curse duties before the pull.

facts.label: Demonic Sacrifice (snapshot)
facts.value: Sacrificing your Imp gives 15% more Shadow damage for 2 hours; summoning any demon cancels the effect, so you fight without a pet while it lasts
facts.recheck: Checked against the 16 October talent data; not yet re-checked against the 10 November data.

facts.label: Group utility
facts.value: Healthstones (a heal off the potion cooldown), Soulstone, Ritual of Summoning, curses, Banish, the Imp's Blood Pact and Fire Shield, and the Felhunter's Spell Lock and Devour Magic
facts.note: Icy Veins and Warcraft Tavern Forever guides.

facts.label: No Shadow Priest boost
facts.value: Shadow Weaving is personal now, so Shadow Priests no longer amplify Warlock Shadow damage

facts.label: Weapon imbue
facts.value: Spellstone adds Shadow damage and spell haste and stacks with Wizard Oil
facts.note: talentsforever's datamined top rank: +2% haste and up to +21 Shadow damage for 2 hours.

facts.label: Classic 1.12 caster kit (reference)
facts.value: Flask of Supreme Power, Greater Arcane Elixir, Brilliant Wizard Oil, Major Mana Potion, Mageblood Potion, Demonic or Dark Rune, Nightfin Soup, Runn Tum Tuber Surprise

facts.label: Forever alchemy
facts.value: Healing potions moved to First Aid, new elixirs include Minor Arcane Elixir, and flasks are brewed at a portable Alchemy Laboratory camp object

facts.label: Healthstones
facts.value: Heal as if fully talented in the files: the Major Healthstone heals 1,440 (Classic untalented: 1,200)

facts.label: Demonic Knowledge (snapshot)
facts.value: You and your demon gain spell damage up to 33% of your level while a demon is summoned (rank 1)
facts.recheck: Checked against the 16 October talent data; not yet re-checked against the 10 November data.

facts.label: Sacrifice and Pact
facts.value: Demonic Sacrifice lasts 2 hours, and Demonic Pact keeps it when you summon a different demon, so both effects can be combined for the first time

facts.label: Master Demonologist pairing
facts.value: Imp: Fire damage. Voidwalker: less physical damage taken. Succubus or Incubus: Shadow damage. Felhunter: less magic damage taken

facts.label: Hit for Demonology (snapshot)
facts.value: Demonology has no hit talent; Suppression sits in Affliction row 1 (1% hit at rank 1, 5 ranks)
facts.recheck: Checked against the 16 October talent data; not yet re-checked against the 10 November data.

facts.label: Decimation (snapshot)
facts.value: Soul Fire's cooldown is 45% shorter at rank 1, and Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain on a target under 35% health speeds up Soul Fire for 10 sec
facts.recheck: Checked against the 16 October talent data; not yet re-checked against the 10 November data.

facts.label: Pet tanking in raids
facts.value: Unproven. Warcraft Tavern says Demonic Brand makes it achievable; Blizzard only says Demonology keeps enemies focused on the pet

facts.label: Demonic Brand threat (snapshot)
facts.value: Searing Pain generates 17% less threat at rank 1, and Shadow damage from the brand carries high threat
facts.recheck: Checked against the 16 October talent data; not yet re-checked against the 10 November data.

facts.label: Pet utility
facts.value: Imp: Blood Pact and Fire Shield. Felhunter: Spell Lock and Devour Magic
facts.note: Icy Veins and Warcraft Tavern Forever guides.

facts.label: Ritual of Summoning
facts.value: Meeting stones reportedly do not summon, so the Warlock ritual (you plus two helpers) is the only summon
facts.note: Warcraft Tavern, based on the BlizzCon demo.

facts.label: Onyxia
facts.value: Every raider carries their own Drakefire Amulet, and Blizzard asks raids to build fire resistance before the fight

facts.label: Weapon imbue
facts.value: Firestone (Fire damage and spell crit) or Spellstone (Shadow damage and spell haste); both stack with Wizard Oil

facts.label: Classic 1.12 caster kit (reference)
facts.value: Flask of Supreme Power, Greater Arcane Elixir, Brilliant Wizard Oil, Major Mana Potion, Mageblood Potion, Demonic or Dark Rune, Nightfin Soup, Sagefish Delight

facts.label: Camp buffs
facts.value: Profession camp objects give weaker copies of class buffs that do not stack with the real ones; you sit at the camp for at least 1 minute
facts.note: Warcraft Tavern. Whether they last into raids is not stated.

facts.label: Incinerate
facts.value: 31-point talent: 2.5 sec cast, 25% more damage on Immolated targets

facts.label: Cast speed (snapshot)
facts.value: Bane: Shadow Bolt, Immolate and Incinerate 0.1 sec faster and Soul Fire 0.4 sec faster at rank 1, 5 ranks
facts.recheck: Checked against the 16 October talent data; not yet re-checked against the 10 November data.

facts.label: Destruction damage (snapshot)
facts.value: Agonizing Flames: 3% more Destruction damage and 3% Searing Pain crit at rank 1. Ruin: 20% more Destruction crit damage at rank 1
facts.recheck: Checked against the 16 October talent data; not yet re-checked against the 10 November data.

facts.label: Hit for Destruction (snapshot)
facts.value: Destruction has no hit talent; Suppression (Affliction row 1) is the Warlock's hit source
facts.recheck: Checked against the 16 October talent data; not yet re-checked against the 10 November data.

facts.label: Classic 1.12 hit cap (reference only)
facts.value: 16% spell hit against bosses three levels higher; 1% of spells always miss

facts.label: Improved Shadow Bolt
facts.value: Now boosts only your own Shadow damage, so it no longer helps the raid

facts.label: Bane of Havoc
facts.value: One target for 5 min takes 15% of the damage you deal to other targets, which pays off on fights with more than one enemy

facts.label: Mana (snapshot)
facts.value: Cataclysm: Destruction spells cost 3% less mana at rank 1
facts.recheck: Checked against the 16 October talent data; not yet re-checked against the 10 November data.

facts.label: Curse of the Elements (files)
facts.value: 4 ranks; the top rank lowers magic resistances by 75 and adds 10% magic damage taken from all schools
facts.note: talentsforever datamine; Blizzard confirms it now covers all magic schools.

facts.label: Healthstones and Soulstone
facts.value: Healthstones heal outside the potion cooldown, and the Soulstone gives a combat resurrection
facts.note: Icy Veins and Warcraft Tavern Forever guides.

facts.label: Weapon imbue
facts.value: Firestone (Fire damage and spell crit) matches Incinerate and Conflagrate; Spellstone (Shadow damage and spell haste) matches Shadow Bolt; both stack with Wizard Oil

facts.label: Classic 1.12 caster kit (reference)
facts.value: Flask of Supreme Power, Greater Arcane Elixir, Brilliant Wizard Oil, Major Mana Potion, Mageblood Potion, Demonic or Dark Rune, Runn Tum Tuber Surprise, Sagefish Delight

facts.label: Classic 1.12 fire resistance sources (reference)
facts.value: Onyxia Scale Cloak (+16), Drakefire Amulet (+15), Juju Ember (+15 for 10 min), Greater Fire Resistance cloak enchant (+15), fire protection potions

facts.label: World buffs in raids
facts.value: Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer is marked 'No effect while in a raid instance' in Forever data
